title: KR-Housing-LongRAG-Bench
description: A copyright-safe Korean long-context benchmark for evaluating long-context LLMs, RAG systems, and table/tool pipelines over real housing announcements, public tabular data, and housing statutes. The public release contains QA labels, evidence locators, deterministic predicates, answerability labels, split and provider/region metadata, and long-context-bundle references. It does not redistribute raw PDF/HWP/HWPX documents, bundle text, or API keys. v0.9.2 keeps the 1,997 QA, their questions and the splits of v0.9 (dev 1,608 / test_public 389) unchanged. Human review: three annotators (the first author and two native Korean speakers who are not domain experts) independently reviewed all 347 evaluated test_public items, and the author adjudicated the 39 items that any annotator flagged. 29 items have an error, 8.4% [5.9, 11.7] Wilson 95%. Correction: v0.9.1 reported a one-author sample audit of 118 items with 1 error (0.8% [0.1, 4.6]); under the three-annotator review the same 118 items have 8 errors. The v0.9.1 record is left as published. Gold fixes (data/v0.9.2/gold_fixes.json): 24 items get corrected gold (23 accept any of several answers the source supports, 1 replaced), and 5 ill-posed items are excluded from evaluation but kept in the data. With the cross_document_legal_reasoning family still excluded as in v0.9.1, the evaluation scope is 1,883 items (dev 1,541 / test_public 342). Dev was not reviewed by people: 54 dev items carry unverified automatic flags for the same defect patterns and are still evaluated. data/errata_v0.9.2.csv lists the 29 confirmed test errors and the 54 dev flags; data/errata_v0.9.1.csv is unchanged. Judges: claude-sonnet-5-5 is the primary LLM judge (98.8% agreement, kappa 0.975, with 80 human labels; 100/100 identical verdicts on a re-run) and gpt-4.1-mini is the secondary judge (99.5% agreement with Claude on in-scope test verdicts). Per-item verdicts, per-annotator review labels, and the judging and scoring scripts are included. Known issue: the mix_multiprovider_256k bundle is longer than its tier name (about 710k tokens; 37 items). The QA content comes from the v0.8 LLM-triage repair build. The release is not leaderboard-ready and has no sealed hidden split.
